body:
Adds `research/saturation-twin`: a twin without actuator limits overstates mean time to loss of control of an unstable saturating plant (6,295× at noise sd 1), exponentially in 1/s². The twin ranks gains correctly (deadbeat best) but not in scale. Exact exit times from an integral equation, checked against grid refinement and Monte Carlo. Stylised, scalar, preliminary.

Includes README bullet, `site/projects.json` entry, 8 tests, results, and whitepaper. `python site/build.py` prints ok.
